params.name: website-id
params.description: Your Website ID / Property ID (PID). Enables the system to generate the appropriate link code in the response. Must match the Website PID used to register for the developer key.

params.name: advertiser-ids
params.description: Comma-separated advertiser CIDs, or `joined`, or `notjoined`. An empty string currently behaves the same as `notjoined`.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Restricts results by keywords found in the link's advertiser name, link name, description and advertiser-tagged search keywords. Supports simple boolean operators `+` and `-`; default logic is OR.

params.name: category
params.description: Comma-separated advertiser SUB-category. Top-level/parent categories are not searchable. See the enumerations page.

params.name: link-type
params.description: Limits results to a specific link type. Product links are not available here — use the Product Search API. See the enumerations page.

params.name: promotion-type
params.description: Promotion type. Required if using promotion-start-date or promotion-end-date.

params.name: promotion-start-date
params.description: Promotion start date in MM/DD/YYYY format. Blank returns any start date.

params.name: promotion-end-date
params.description: Promotion end date in MM/DD/YYYY format, or the literal value `ongoing` for a promotion with no end date. Blank returns any end date.

params.name: page-number
params.description: Page of the result set to view. Defaults to 1.

params.name: records-per-page
params.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to 100 for this API.

params.name: language
params.description: Language the link was set at, using an accepted language code.

params.name: allow-deep-linking
params.description: Limit to links whose destination URL can be modified.

params.name: event-name
params.description: The event or occurrence the link relates to. One event at a time.

params.name: link-Id
params.description: The AdId / Link ID of an individual link. One at a time. Only active links are returned; invalid, deleted or archived links return 0 results.

params.name: last-updated
params.description: Return links updated since this date, inclusive. MM/DD/YYYY format.

params.name: cross-device-only
params.description: Limit to links supporting cross-device tracking.

params.name: mobile-app-download
params.description: Limit to links that direct the user to an App Store download.

params.name: mobile-optimized
params.description: Limit to links the advertiser flagged as mobile-optimized.

params.name: targeted-country
params.description: Two-letter country code, one at a time. Appears as `targeted-countries` in the response.

items.docs: Find links across all advertisers in one call, filtered by keywords, category, link type, promotion type, relationship status, language, target country and more. All parameter names and values are case-insensitive. You must supply at least one optional parameter — an empty request returns zero results. Publishers only. Documented call limit: 25 calls per minute. The same endpoint serves the Automated Offer Feed for financial advertisers.
